name: canvas
description: Operate the Goticket canvas through the canvas_management MCP: query project and requirement progress, submit design requests, quote and generate images, and edit the canvas live in the built-in browser.

displayDescription.zh: 连接未来船票画布，查项目与需求进度、提设计需求、按积分报价生图，并在内置浏览器里实时编辑画布。
displayDescription.en: Connect to the Goticket canvas to check project and requirement progress, submit design requests, quote credits before generating images, and edit the canvas live in the built-in browser.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有什么待处理的需求？
defaultInitPrompt.en: What requirement tasks are pending for me?

quickPrompts.zh: 我有什么待处理的需求？
quickPrompts.en: What requirement tasks are pending for me?

quickPrompts.zh: 看看我的画布项目现在进展到哪了
quickPrompts.en: Show the current progress of my canvas projects

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我提一个新的设计需求
quickPrompts.en: Help me create a new design request

description.zh: 连接后可查项目和需求进度、提设计需求、生成图片。首次连接用 mark-system 小程序扫码授权。
description.en: Query project and requirement progress, submit design requests and generate images after connecting. Scan with the mark-system mini program to authorize on first use.
